mapper.select: SELECT t.business_id AS id, t.plan_id, t.task_key, t.expert_id, t.status, t.objective, t.dependencies, t.created_at FROM coordinator_task t JOIN coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.conversation_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.task_key

SELECT h.business_id AS id, h.task_id, h.request_type, h.question, h.status, h.decision, h.expires_at FROM human_request h JOIN project_message m ON m.business_id = h.message_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.conversation_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY h.created_at
